subject: ventures/ids-model-check
professional: a senior BIM information manager (ISO 19650) who writes and enforces IDS files, with a buildingSMART IDS implementer's eye; first checks: buildingSMART's IDS 1.0 test pairs, agreement with IfcTester on real models, SI conversion from project units (including US-customary offset units such as Fahrenheit, which US MEP models carry), BCF 2.1 schema validity, and whether CI gates the conformance claim

evidence.correctness: Ran ci-fetch.sh (buildingSMART IDS suite at 870f9c4, BCF 2.1 XSDs) and scored the 334 pairs with my own shell runner (/tmp/claude-0/runner.sh: expected verdict from buildingSMART's file-name prefix, observed from cli.mjs exit code, not eval/run-testcases.mjs): pass->pass 187, fail->fail 120, invalid->fail 27; no valid case wrong, no invalid case passed. IfcTester 0.9.0.post1 vs cli.mjs --json, per spec status, applicable count and failing GlobalIds (my /tmp/claude-0/cmp.py): 18/18 on each of Building-Hvac, Infra-Rail, Infra-Road x infrastructure-and-mep.ids.xml; 7/7 and 6/7 on the tiny house (the 7th is the documented multiple-xs:pattern case). BCF export of the sample validates against markup.xsd, visinfo.xsd and version.xsd with xmllint (4+4+1 files). NEW WRONG NUMBER: a model written by IfcOpenShell's unit.add_conversion_based_unit('fahrenheit') carries IFC4's own example encoding, IFCCONVERSIONBASEDUNITWITHOFFSET(..., IFCMEASUREWITHUNIT(IFCREAL(1.8), KELVIN), -459.67), from the spec text 'f = k * 1.8 - 459.67'. A space with SpaceTemperatureMax 77 F should read (77+459.67)/1.8 = 298.15 K; the checker read -688.806 K (ids.mjs:296 added offset*factor with the wrong sign and took 1.8 as K per degree) and failed an IDS requiring 298.15. IfcTester is also wrong there (138.6). Fixed in this PR; score is before the fix.
evidence.completeness: STEP, ifcXML and ifczip; --json, --bcf, CI wiring all exercised above. The 2026-11-19 audit's feature list still works; the IDS editor was again not driven in a browser. NEXT.md still says no real coordinator's project IDS has been run.
evidence.verification: node --test '*.test.mjs' with corpora fetched: 627 tests, 627 pass, 0 skipped, 14.2 s (was 278 with 2 headline tests skipped). platform/ci/run_venture_tests.py:614-640 now runs ventures/ids-model-check/ci-fetch.sh before the suites and fails the venture if the fetch fails, so CI gates the 334 pairs and BCF XSD test. Mutants: the three unit mutants that survived on 2026-11-19 (SQUARE_ not squared, Celsius offset 0, conversion unit ignoring base prefix) are now caught by engine.test.mjs:603. Two new core mutants survived the full suite before this PR: CUBIC_ prefix cubed -> squared, GRAM factor 1e-3 dropped; and IfcConversionBasedUnitWithOffset had no test at all (the sign error above). The new test in this PR catches all four (offset sign, 1.8 inversion, cubic, gram).
evidence.craft: Read ids.mjs unitScale (277-305) and the unitOf/values path (776-835); engine code remains dependency-free with stated rules; errors surface. README.md has grown from 73 KB to 160 KB (2,384 lines) of dated changelog prose; llms.txt was cut to 68 lines but 7 lines still exceed 1,500 characters.
evidence.claims: Checked: 334/334 (pass, recomputed); IfcTester agreement except multiple patterns (pass, 54/54 + 13/14); BCF 2.1 (pass); llms.txt 'Not covered' no longer lists ids.xsd validation (pass, now only geometry/clash); README:2032 'unit conversion' tested (pass: engine.test.mjs:603); README:2213 claimed SI conversion including conversion-based units, which was false for offset units (fail, fixed and README line extended in this PR); disclaimer index.html:156 (pass); served-copy.mjs: no placeholder origin (pass).
evidence.fitness: The BIM manager's job (drop model + client IDS, read failures with reasons, export BCF, gate in CI) completes as on 2026-11-19. For a US MEP consultant whose model uses Fahrenheit, every temperature requirement returned a wrong verdict before this PR.
evidence.domain: Against IDS 1.0 (values in SI) and IFC4 IfcConversionBasedUnitWithOffset (its definition and Fahrenheit example, read from the IFC4 documentation shipped in IfcOpenShell's express/DocEntity.csv and DocAttribute.csv): facets, tolerance, pattern semantics, type inheritance follow the standard; offset units departed from it. IFC's own example runs its factor SI->unit, opposite to plain conversion units (1 inch = 0.0254 m); the fix reads SI = (value - offset) x factor and inverts a 1.8 temperature factor, which agrees with both the spec example and a 5/9-factor encoding.

defects.what: IfcConversionBasedUnitWithOffset converted with the offset's sign reversed and IFC4's example factor (1.8 K for Fahrenheit, SI->unit) taken as K per degree: 77 F read as -688.806 K instead of 298.15 K, so every temperature requirement on a Fahrenheit model (IfcOpenShell's and the spec's own encoding) got a wrong verdict.
Offset units, CUBIC_ prefixes and the GRAM -> kg factor had no test: seeded mutants on cubic and gram survived all 627 tests, and the offset path was never exercised.
README (160 KB, up from 73 KB) is a dated changelog; the usage a BIM manager needs is buried.

verdict: Every prior defect but the README-length one is closed: the 2026-11-19 unit mutants are now caught, and CI fetches buildingSMART's suite so the 334-pair claim is gated (627/627 tests, none skipped). Independent checks agree again: my own runner scores the 334 pairs right, IfcTester matches on 54/54 IFC 4.3 specs and 13/14 starter specs (the documented pattern case), BCF validates against the 2.1 XSDs. New high defect: Fahrenheit-style offset units were converted wrongly (77 F read as -688.8 K, not 298.15 K, in the IFC4 example's own encoding), untested along with cubic prefixes and grams; fixed with a test in PR #20105, after scoring. Meets the bar on the computed gates, with the offset defect counted against correctness.
